name: Amakusa (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Amakusa city emblem in light blue, navy and green: light blue and navy curved strokes like a wave, with a green disc.
history: Municipal flag of Amakusa, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Amakusa city emblem — light blue and navy curved strokes like a wave, with a green disc
